qs.s: Face à ce ___, il ne savait pas quelle décision prendre.
qs.en: Faced with this dilemma, he did not know what decision to make.

qs.en: The doctor was faced with a difficult ethical dilemma.

qs.en: Accept this position abroad or stay and disappoint his boss — what a dilemma, caught between two impossible choices!

qs.en: This MP is a true progressive: he defends the rights of all minorities.

qs.en: Journalists interviewed several progressives about their vision of social reform.

qs.s: En tant que ___, elle croit que la société doit évoluer vers plus d'égalité et de justice.
qs.en: As a progressive, she believes society must evolve toward greater equality and justice.

qs.en: This movement brings together progressives convinced that structural change is indispensable.

qs.en: The government adopted a progressive tax policy to reduce inequalities.

qs.en: He defines himself as a progressive committed to the fight for social rights.

qs.en: At the zoo, the children watch the polar bear in its enclosure with wonder.

qs.en: I spotted a bear in the forest this morning.

qs.en: At the circus, a trained bear was performing incredible tricks.
